mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_closet_pairing p WHERE p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_closet_pairing p WHERE p.helper_id = #{helperId} AND

SELECT p.pairing_id, p.owner_id, o.name AS owner_name, p.helper_id, h.name AS helper_name, p.permission, p.status, p.issued_by, p.notify_owner, p.created_at, p.approved_at FROM tb_closet_pairing p JOIN tb_user o ON o.user_id = p.owner_id JOIN tb_user h ON h.user_id = p.helper_id WHERE (p.owner_id = #{userId} OR p.helper_id = #{userId}) AND ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.pairing_id DESC
SELECT u.name FROM tb_user u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.pairing_id FROM tb_closet_proxy_action a WHERE a.notified_at IS NULL GROUP BY a.pairing_id HAVING max(a.created_at) <= #{quietBefore} OR min(a.created_at) <= #{waitedBefore} ORDER BY a.pairing_id
